patch.content: /dts-v1/;#include <nordic/nrf52840.dtsi>#include <dt-bindings/zmk/keys.h>/ {    model = "Nordic nRF52840 DK";    compatible = "nordic,nrf52840-dk";    chosen {        zephyr,console = &uart0;        pwm-led3 = &pwm_led3;    };    leds {        compatible = "gpio-leds";        led0: led_0 {            gpios = <&gpio0 13 GPIO_ACTIVE_LOW>;            label = "Green LED 0";        };        led1: led_1 {            gpios = <&gpio0 14 GPIO_ACTIVE_LOW>;            label = "PWM LED 3";        };    };    arduino_header {        compatible = "arduino,uno-r3-headers";        #address-cells = <1>;        #size-cells = <0>;        // Digital pins        arduino_d0: pin_d0 {            gpio-pin = <20>;        arduino_d4: pin_d4 {            gpio-pin = <22>;        };        arduino_d5: pin_d5 {            gpio-pin = <23>;        };        arduino_d6: pin_d6 {            gpio-pin = <24>;        };        arduino_d7: pin_d7 {            gpio-pin = <25>;        };        arduino_d8: pin_d8 {            gpio-pin = <10>;        };        arduino_d9: pin_d9 {            gpio-pin = <9>;        };        arduino_d10: pin_d10 {            gpio-pin = <8>;        };
